raw:
Timo Glock's 2012 teammate at Marussia was **Charles Pic**.

The 2012 final standings list both Glock and Pic as Marussia drivers, and they are the only two Marussia drivers listed. The race reports I retrieved don't show either driver's race-by-race entries, so I couldn't confirm from the search results that Pic started every race. That the pairing lasted the whole season comes from my own knowledge, not the retrieved material.

ANSWER: Charles Pic
